_meanings:
.²1 A guide, leader, conductor.
.²2 A chief, master, head, lord.
.²3 A pre-eminent or principal person, distinguished personage; {#sEnyanAyakaH#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²4 A general, commander.
.²5 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The hero of a poetic composition (a play or drama); (according
 to <ls>S. D.</ls> there are four main kinds of {#nAyaka#}:-- {#DIrodAtta, DIrodData#},
 {#DIralalita#}, and {#DIrapraSAnta#}, <ab>q. v.</ab>; these are again subdivided,
 the total number of kinds being 48; see <ls>S. D. 64-75</ls>. The Rasamañjarī
 mentions 3 classes {#pati, upapati#} and {#vESika#}; <ls n="S. D.">95. 110</ls>).
.²6 The central gem of a necklace; {#‘nAyako netari SrezWe hAramaDyamaRAvapi’ iti viSvaH#}.
.²7 A paradigm or leading example; {#daSEte strIzu nAyakAH#}.
.²8 An epithet of Śākyamuni.
